component.name: Arxis Deck
component.summary: Steam Deck store for software and game tools

description.p: Arxis Deck is an app store made for Steam Deck Gaming Mode: full screen at 1280×800 and driven entirely by the controller.

ul.li: Install compatibility tools, launchers, emulators and utilities from Flathub
Apps are installed for your user, so no password is needed and SteamOS updates keep them
Search all of Flathub with an on-screen keyboard
See downloads, installed apps and categories, and launch apps with A
Install Proton-GE for Steam and emulator AppImages from GitHub, with checksum checks
Larger text, reduced motion and Steam's on-screen keyboard for search

description.p: New app ID io.github.APapinian.ArxisDeck, matching the GitHub account (formerly fatih-bucaklioglu). Remove 0.2.0 first: it used the old ID.

Steam Deck test build: Proton-GE and AppImage installs, app details and permissions before installing, activity history, offline handling, About & diagnostics, text size, reduced motion and the Steam keyboard for search. Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.
First test build: controller navigation, Flathub install, uninstall, search and launch.
